name: Adam Todd
researchKeywords: pharmaceutical public health, health inequalities, deprescribing, palliative care
bio: Adam Todd is Professor of Pharmaceutical Public Health and Deputy Head of the School of Pharmacy at Newcastle University. He is a qualified pharmacist and leads an interdisciplinary programme of research spanning pharmacy, public health and health inequalities.
researchFocus: Adam applies pharmaceutical knowledge to prevent disease, prolong life, promote health and reduce health inequalities across different populations. His work includes deprescribing, palliative care and public health interventions delivered through community pharmacy.
